title: Pentagon Releases Fresh UFO Videos: New Footage Of Unidentified Objects Emerges
description: The Pentagon has released fresh videos and material linked to unidentified flying objects, offering new footage for the public to examine. The latest release adds to a growing collection of unidentified aerial phenomena records made public by the U.S. government. The footage has renewed interest in mysterious objects observed by military personnel and raises fresh questions about what exactly was captured. While the videos show unidentified phenomena, they do not by themselves confirm extraterrestrial life.

title: ‘Age of Disclosure’ director on Pentagon release: Reports of ‘triangle-shape UAP seen over sensitive military sites’
description: Dan Farah, director and producer of "Age of Disclosure" joins Elex Michaelson to discuss the latest as the Pentagon released a fifth batch of UFO files.
